register.labelZh: BLAST 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: blast off 可以直接描述火箭或太空船開始升空,展開太空旅程。；blast out 可以描述以極大音量播放的音樂、警告和廣播訊息。；blast away 可以描述大炮、太空船或遊戲角色持續開火。；blast something away 可以描述工人用爆炸移除岩石、牆壁或其他物件。
register.summaryEn: Blast off gives you a direct way to describe a rocket or spacecraft beginning its journey into space. Blast out helps you describe music, warnings and announcements that are played extremely loudly. Blast away can describe cannons, spaceships or game characters firing continuously. Blast something away can describe workers removing rock, walls or other objects with explosions.

contextsEn: Talk about rockets and space travel
Describe very loud music and messages
Describe repeated firing in games, films and shows
